entities.name: Hein ten Hoff

entities.summary: Hein ten Hoff was a German boxer and Präsident des Bundes Deutscher Berufsboxer (BDB). He was the son of a Dutch peasant, who left The Netherlands for Germany in the end of the 1930s, and became a German citizen.
